text_blocks.snippet: Mega Greninja ex is a Water-type Stage 2 Pokémon card from the Pokémon TCG expansion Mega Evolution: Chaos Rising.
snippet_highlighted_words: Water-type Stage 2 Pokémon card from the Pokémon TCG expansion Mega Evolution: Chaos Rising

list.snippet: Card Numbers: #22 (Ultra Rare / Standard Holo), #100/086 (Ultra Rare), and #116/086 (Special Illustration Rare)
Weakness / Retreat: Lightning (Lx2) weakness, 1 Retreat Cost
Ability — Mortal Shuriken: Once during your turn (if in the Active Spot), discard a Basic Water Energy from your hand to place 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
Attack — Ninja Spinner [WW]: Does 120+ damage; you may put a Water Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand to make the attack do 80 more damage (total 200).
Pull Rate: Estimated at around 0.10% (roughly 1 in 956 booster packs) for the high-rarity versions.

Market Pricing: Standard foil versions sell around $8–$11, while the Special Illustration Rare Mega Greninja ex - 116/086 - ME04: Chaos Rising - Pokemon - TCGplayer ranges roughly between $120 and $160+ depending on condition.

list.snippet: Collector Sentiment: According to a consensus on Reddit r/PokemonTCG, many collectors note that the secondary market prices for chase copies are exceptionally high and sought-after.
Competitive Play: Tracked on Limitless TCG as part of the Mega Greninja archetype in the current standard/expanded format.
Products: Also available via the Mega Greninja ex Premium Collection box, which includes 8 booster packs and foil promo cards.
